title: Zesty Tunisian Wood Ear Mushroom Tagine
description: Savory and velvety Tunisian dish featuring wood ear mushrooms, perfect for a date night, this recipe is low in glycemic index and cooked to perfection in a molcajete.
instructions: Rinse the dried wood ear mushrooms and soak them in hot water for 20 minutes.
Heat the olive oil in the molcajete over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion to the molcajete and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the molcajete and cook for 1 minute.
Add the ground cumin and smoked paprika to the molcajete and cook for 1 minute.
Add the soaked wood ear mushrooms, dates, chicken broth, salt, and black pepper to the molcajete.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Use a spoon to occasionally stir and caramelize the mixture.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
